description: This file contains internal utility classes for message handling and error reporting within the MigraDoc.DocumentObjectModel, including methods for generating message strings and exceptions related to document object modeling.

classes.name: MSG
classes.description: Static class providing message strings and exception methods for internal use within MigraDoc's document object model, including error message generation and predefined exceptions.

methods.name: SomeMessage
methods.description: Returns a formatted string with embedded variables, demonstrating message formatting.

methods.name: ArgumentException_StyleExpected
methods.description: Creates an ArgumentException indicating that a given type was expected to be a Style.

methods.name: ArgumentException_UndefinedBaseStyle
methods.description: Creates an ArgumentException indicating that a specified base style is undefined.

methods.name: InvalidDocumentObjectType
methods.description: Returns a string indicating that a document object is not valid in the current context.

methods.name: DdlParserException_NewlineInString
methods.description: Creates a DdlParserException indicating that a newline occurred inside a string literal.

methods.name: DdlParserException_EscapeSequenceNotAllowed
methods.description: Creates a DdlParserException indicating that an escape sequence was not allowed.

methods.name: InvalidOperationException_MergeDownTooLarge
methods.description: Generates an InvalidOperationException indicating that a MergeDown value exceeds the table's row count.

methods.name: InvalidOperationException_MergeRightTooLarge
methods.description: Generates an InvalidOperationException indicating that a MergeRight value exceeds the table's column count.
